overview: Put a sapling in a flower pot and it grows a little tree at pot size. Sneak and cut it back with shears and it comes up as a different shape.

1.0.1: The same mod under a new version number, so the release had a file that could go up.
1.0.0: Every sapling the game will pot grows a bonsai, pruned into another form with shears.
A flower pot in or on a decorated pot is a cachepot, with room for the larger forms.
An oak with a full crown, a spruce three tiers high, a jungle giant on four trunks.
Bamboo, the huge mushrooms, the nether fungi, a saguaro from a cactus, deadwood from a dead bush.
The chorus flower, tall flowers, seeds and trailing plants grow from what the game already pots.
They come back when the pot is emptied.
